headline: Russia's Banking Strain, IDF Strikes, and Red Sea Threats Dominate July 7
subheadline: Intelligence confirms Crimea funds funneled via credit and loans to Russian military, while IDF destroyed 90+ terrorist sites in Lebanon's Haddatha, eliminating 20 militants.
lede: Russia's banking system is under severe strain as Crimea war costs are funneled through credit and loans to military companies, according to European intelligence. In Lebanon, IDF forces destroyed over 90 terrorist infrastructure sites in Haddatha village, eliminating more than 20 militants and 150 weapons, including RPGs and anti-tank missiles. The UK Maritime Trade Operations issued attack warning 080-26 for the Red Sea, underscoring ongoing maritime security threats. Meanwhile, Russian forces launched a large-scale strike on Kiev and surrounding regions, killing at least 14 civilians and prompting evacuations in Vyshneve.

sections.title: Russian Strike on Kiev Intensifies Civilian Casualties
sections.body: Russian forces launched a large-scale strike on Kiev and surrounding regions using long-range precision-guided weapons and attack drones, targeting military airfields in Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava, Cherkasy, and Chernihiv. The strike killed at least 14 civilians and injured 60, with casualties reported in Vyshneve, Podilsk, and Darnitsa districts. Evacuations were conducted in Vyshneve, moving 500 people and damaging 13 hectares of residential buildings. The United States and European Union are reportedly supporting Ukraine’s defense amid ongoing negotiations to end the conflict.

sections.title: IDF Strikes Decimate Hezbollah Infrastructure in Lebanon
sections.body: IDF forces destroyed over 90 terrorist infrastructure sites in Lebanon's Haddatha village, eliminating more than 20 militants and 150 weapons, including RPGs, anti-tank missiles, and 'Klyatsnikov' firearms. The UK Maritime Trade Operations issued attack warning 080-26 for the Red Sea, highlighting ongoing maritime security threats. Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps commander Sarafdar Sultanlu was killed in a vehicle accident during return from a funeral caravan for Ayatollah Khamenei's empty coffin. Additionally, IDF targeted four Hezbollah suspects near Al-Khifa in southern Lebanon with air strikes, and the Iraqi Islamic Resistance Movement Al-Nujaba participated in funeral ceremonies for Hezbollah leader and Ayatollah Khamenei.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The data indicates a widening strain on Russia’s financial infrastructure, with Crimea war costs funneled through credit and loans to military firms, potentially limiting future operational capacity. Simultaneously, IDF operations in Lebanon have intensified, destroying significant Hezbollah infrastructure and personnel, while maritime threats in the Red Sea persist, as evidenced by UKMTO warnings. The continued use of long-range precision weapons and drones by Russian forces, coupled with the threat of additional massed strikes on Kiev, signals a sustained escalation that could prompt further international support for Ukraine.
